sources.name: Policía Nacional — Denuncias
sources.description: Official Policía Nacional guidance on reporting a crime in person or online and bringing identification plus a list of stolen items with their make, model, serial number, or IMEI where available.

sources.name: Policía Nacional — Oficina Virtual de Denuncias
sources.description: Official Policía Nacional online complaint service describing which theft and loss situations can be started through the Oficina Virtual de Denuncias and which situations are excluded.

sources.name: Movistar — Bloquear línea móvil por robo
sources.description: Official Movistar guidance to suspend a mobile line after theft or loss through the customer area and to report the theft to the police.

sources.name: Vodafone — Qué hacer si pierdes o te roban tu dispositivo
sources.description: Official Vodafone guidance for suspending a line and blocking a SIM after loss or theft, including the route through a Vodafone shop and requesting a replacement SIM.

sources.name: Orange — Qué hacer si te roban el móvil o lo pierdes
sources.description: Official Orange guidance to block a SIM through Mi Orange, customer support, or a shop after a mobile is lost or stolen.

sources.name: Yoigo — Me han robado el móvil o lo he perdido
sources.description: Official Yoigo guidance to block a SIM temporarily through Mi Yoigo and obtain a replacement SIM after loss or theft.

sources.name: Apple Support — Si te roban el iPhone o el iPad
sources.description: Official Apple guidance to mark an iPhone or iPad as lost, erase it remotely when necessary, contact the mobile operator and authorities, review the Apple Account, and submit an AppleCare+ theft-and-loss claim when covered.

sources.name: Ayuda de Android — Cómo borrar, encontrar o proteger un dispositivo Android perdido
sources.description: Official Google/Android guidance to locate, mark as lost, or erase an Android device remotely, including account, connectivity, battery, and Localizador requirements and the IMEI reference.

sources.name: Banco de España — Uso fraudulento
sources.description: Official Banco de España guidance to notify the bank immediately after loss or theft of a payment card, request a block, report the incident, and check for fraudulent transactions.
